full_regression.path_note: Command and environment paths are shown relative to the repository; the wrapper resolved them to absolute workspace paths. Use a fresh trace destination on reproduction.
full_regression.scope: Complete one-process suite with opt-in outcome/Qt journal and separate external observer. No competing maintainer build/test jobs; no retries or deadline changes.

source_freeze.scope: All Python files under src, tests and tools; SHA256 of UTF-8 text normalized to LF, then SHA256 of sorted compact path-to-hash JSON.

resource_observation.scope: Separate read-only observer of the actual CPython pytest runtime beneath the Windows venv redirector. Began during collection. Children excluded; samples can miss peaks. No grading or source instrumentation.
resource_observation.limits: Sampled actual pytest runtime only; child resources are excluded. Five-second samples can miss peaks. Collection began before the corrected observer. The initial resources.jsonl sampled the Windows venv launcher and is excluded from pytest resource totals. No whole-application speedup or old-machine performance claim.

offline_selfcheck.scope: Fresh isolated offline harness; no live sensors, model startup or real containment readiness claim.

focused_evidence.scope: Controlled baseline/corrected scheduling pairs and 51-case resource/security selection.
Matched native ACL measurements, 38-case security gate and instrumented comprehensive integration.

native_tests.scope: Both native watchdog test groups, run sequentially offline after full Python completion; no source changes or deployment. Initial SDK-root configuration failure occurred before test execution and is recorded separately.

static_checks.ruff_command: venv/Scripts/python.exe -m ruff check src tests tools

limitations: The exact physical trigger of the historical failures was not retained. Controlled mechanism proofs and this new full-suite result cannot reconstruct it. Focused groups overlap and are not added to this full count.
